Claire: Quick heads-up — BetaCo (cohort 9) showing drop-off after initial signup. They completed self-serve but only 2 active users. Risk of churn if execs don't see value in next 2 weeks.
Omar: Any idea why? onboarding analytics or missing integration? Also tagging as potential renewal risk.
Vik: Looks like webhooks integration never got wired; engineering bandwidth was the blocker. Suggest a tight enablement sprint: 90m workshop + eng office hours + a lightweight showcase dashboard. Offer a 14-day showcase sandbox with a token cap to keep the board engaged.
Zoe (BetaCo): Hi all — correct, our eng lead got pulled onto a blocker. Execs want a short demo for the board in ~10 days. Sandbox access would help them test and craft the dashboard.
Claire: Proposed plan: 1) Provision a 'betaco-showcase' sandbox (US) timeboxed 14d, token cap 30k. 2) 90m enablement Wed 9am PT (hands-on webhook + dashboard). 3) Eng office hours Fri 11am PT. 4) Deliver a 1-page board-ready one-pager with 3 KPIs + 3 sample queries. Prework + prompts in the drive: https://redwood.internal/cs/betaco/showcase
Omar: Infra command (for ops): ```rb prov sandbox --org betaco --env showcase --region us-east-1 --model redwood-medium-v1 --tokens 30000 --timebox 14d```
OncallBot: Sandbox betaco-showcase scheduled for creation by vik at 2160001130.
Vik: Provisioning now. ETA ~20m. Will push credentials via secure share and a sample integration repo (git) for the webhook pattern.
Claire: Also drafting a short ROI blurb (estimated support time saved from reranker + cost overview) to include on the board slide. I'll export p50/p95 latency and a 3-sample prompt set to illustrate value. Adding Gainsight tag 'low_engagement' and note 'at-risk-until-demo'.
Zoe (BetaCo): Please include an ROI snippet on support time saved and an estimate of expected CTR lift if possible. CTO + PM will attend the demo.
Vik: Sandbox ready and creds shared at 2160001145. Link: https://sandbox.redwood/betaco-showcase (creds via secure share). Repo: https://git.redwood/internal/betaco/webhook-sample
Claire: Calendar invites sent (90m enablement Wed 9am PT). Agenda + prework uploaded. Micro-survey (3 Qs) will run immediately after demo and responses will feed into feedback board.
Claire: Next steps recap: 1) Sandbox live (Vik) 2) Enablement Wed 9am (Claire) 3) Eng office hours Fri 11am (Vik) 4) Board one-pager + ROI (Claire) 5) micro-survey & feedback capture (Claire). I'll follow up in #customer-success tomorrow AM with status. :rocket:
